name: Bittersweet Mask
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #220: Crypt of Runes
description: The many iron bars of this iron mask fits tightly around Javownir's head and snout, looking almost as if it was built in place to conform specifically to the shape of his skull with no apparent latch or hinge for it to be removed.
disable: DC 45 Thievery (expert) twice to find the Hidden latches, DC 48 Athletics (master) to wrench the mask open quickly enough to prevent it from triggering before it's destroyed, Dispel Magic (9th-rank; counteract DC 35), or automatic with Spleen's key
reset: The mask resets automatically at the start of the round after it is triggered.

defensiveAbilities.name: Linked to Javownir
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever the mask takes damage, Javownir takes the same damage (Basic DC 44 Reflex Saving Throw save)

offensiveAbilities.name: Toxic Off-gassing
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The mask takes damage, or an Athletics check to wrench it free fails or critically fails

Effect The mask creates a cloud of poison gas in a 20ft Type:emanation around Javownir. Creatures in the area take (6d12+41) Poison Damage damage (Basic DC 44 Fortitude Saving Throw save; Javownir treats the result of this save as one degree of success worse than the rolled result).
